metadata.case_name: NG WING WAH v. CHUN HING METAL AND PLASTIC MOULD FACTORY

plaintiff.occupation_before: "Die and Tool Technician" (described in Workmen's Compensation forms); recruited to learn mould making
plaintiff.education_level: Completed full-time schooling in 1973; evening course in wireless technology 1974-75; completed Forms 1 and 2 (1978-80)

injuries.description: Examination showed that there was extensive soft tissue damage with fractures of the 1st, 2nd & 3rd metacarpals and proximal phalanx of the right thumb. Debridement and K-wire fixation of the fractures were performed under general anaesthesia on the same date.
source: Examination showed that there was extensive soft tissue damage with fractures of the 1st, 2nd & 3rd metacarpals and proximal phalanx of the right thumb. Debridement and K-wire fixation of the fractures were performed under general anaesthesia on the same date.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple sites of hand

injuries.description: The plaintiff had lost most of the muscles in his right hand. The thumb joints had been fused but there was some thumb movement because of the metacarpals stretching from the wrist. There was fusion of the index finger at the metacarpal joint and restriction of movement at the other joints. The middle finger had restriction of movement at all joints and the ring finger restriction at the metacarpo-phalangeal where the finger joins the hand. The fifth finger was normal.
source: The plaintiff had lost most of the muscles in his right hand. The thumb joints had been fused but there was some thumb movement because of the metacarpals stretching from the wrist. There was fusion of the index finger at the metacarpal joint and restriction of movement at the other joints. The middle finger had restriction of movement at all joints and the ring finger restriction at the metacarpo-phalangeal where the finger joins the hand. The fifth finger was normal.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of other specified muscle, fascia or tendon at wrist or hand level

injuries.description: The skin grafts were taken from his thigh leaving an area of raised scarring 4" x 5".
source: The skin grafts were taken from his thigh leaving an area of raised scarring 4" x 5".
injuries.icd_description: Other specified superficial injury of hip or thigh

manifestations.description: Grip with his right hand was 40 lb i.e. 50% of the left hand
Right hand could be properly described as a claw

Limited movement of thumb and fingers; can still write but very slowly with poorly formed characters; cannot open his hand fully and can only grip large objects lightly between thumb and forefinger; difficulty using chopsticks (uses left hand or a spoon)
Raised scarring 4" x 5" on thigh (donor site)

treatments_received: Reconstructive surgery on four separate occasions

losses.description: Permanent impairment and loss of function of right hand including loss of most muscles, fused thumb and index finger, restricted movement of fingers resulting in a claw hand and reduced grip (40 lb i.e. 50% of left hand).
Raised scarring 4" x 5" on thigh from skin grafts.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Difficulty using chopsticks; limited hand function leading to reliance on spoon and slower, less well-formed writing.
Injury prevents performance of much of the work of a mould maker; would have been a qualified moulder earning $3,500 per month but injury curtailed earning capacity.

comparable_cases.injury_description: 30% loss of grip in the right hand. Disability was assessed at 25% but there were some injuries to the leg as well.
Injuries much less serious than present plaintiff.

comparable_cases.case_name: Leung Wing Kai (an infant) v Shen Dik Industrial Co
comparable_cases.injury_description: Middle, index and ring fingers amputated. Disability assessed at 30%.
